# ThemisReviews

> Side-by-side reviews of smart home gear. Start with the system that runs your house, pick the protocol it speaks, then choose the switches, sensors, and locks that work on it. Every price, star rating and review count comes from the product's live Amazon listing on the date shown for that page; nothing is estimated. Each review page scores its products 0-100 on published weights, names award picks, lists which smart home systems each product works with, and flags one listing to avoid.

Machine-readable data: every review page has a JSON twin at the same path with `.json` in place of `.html` (ranked products with ASIN, price, rating, review count, score, systems it works with, specs, pros, cons and the capture date). The site index is https://themisreviews.com/index.json. Each page links its twin with `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">`. Links to Amazon carry our Associates tag; a purchase may earn us a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
